description: Gate a downstream asset on a JSON approval token file — the human-in-the-loop primitive. Missing token = approval_pending; approved:false = approval_rejected; approved:true = passthrough of upstream payload plus approver metadata. Pair with FilesystemMonitorSensorComponent for auto-progression.

outputs.description: Upstream payload, unchanged. Approver / reason / timestamp land in materialization metadata.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset whose value passes through the gate when approved.

approval_dir.label: Approval Dir
approval_dir.description: Directory of approval token JSON files. Filename is `<partition_key>.json` (or `<default_approval_key>.json` when unpartitioned). Accepts local paths (`/tmp/approvals`) OR cloud URIs (`s3://bucket/prefix`, `gs://bucket/prefix`, `abfs://...`). Cloud URIs require the matching fsspec driver (`s3fs` / `gcsfs` / `adlfs`) — required for Dagster+ Serverless or distributed deploys where the local filesystem isn't shared across containers.

default_approval_key.label: Default Approval Key
default_approval_key.description: Token filename stem used when the asset is unpartitioned.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Freshness policy: max lag before stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO date for time-based partition types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name}.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on failure. Rarely useful — a pending approval isn't retry-able. Leave unset unless you want a per-run poll.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data loaded at runtime).
